h1: How do I apply for and track a permit on Newton's online portal?
title: Newton Permit Portal: How to Apply and Track Permits
description: How Newton's online permitting works: the OpenGov account, starting an application, public record search by address, and checking permits are closed.
short_answer: Newton's Inspectional Services takes applications online through Apply for Permits, which requires an OpenGov account. The City also provides a public search by address or record number, which you can use to confirm permits are closed before you make the final payment to a contractor.

facts.text: Use the City's Apply for Permits link to start or manage an application.
An OpenGov account is required for online applications.
The City provides a public search link for address or record-number searches.
Check the permitting website to confirm permits are closed before you pay the contractor in full.

qa.q: Do I need an account to apply?
qa.a: Yes. The City says an OpenGov account is required for online applications.

qa.q: Can I look up permits on my address?
qa.a: Yes. The City provides a public search by address or record number.

qa.q: When should I check my permit status?
qa.a: The City advises checking that permits are closed before you make the final payment to a contractor.

qa.q: Who can I call for help?
qa.a: Inspectional Services at (617) 796-1060, City Hall Room 202.
